name: smartcampus-omnidesk
description: SmartCampus OmniDesk - Omnichannel Incident Management System

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ..
scripts.build: npm run install:all && cd frontend && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run start:dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
